name: dev-wizard
description: A startup wizard for VS Code: continue your last project or scaffold new ones from your own templates. 启动向导：继续上次的工作，或从自定义模板一键新建工程。

commands.title: Dev Wizard: what are we doing today?
Dev Wizard: environment check (环境体检)
Dev Wizard: template doctor (模板体检)
Dev Wizard: install template (安装模板)
Dev Wizard: update templates (更新模板)
Dev Wizard: uninstall template (卸载模板)
Dev Wizard: browse templates (浏览模板)
Dev Wizard: write context.md (生成上下文文件)
Dev Wizard: git init (初始化 git)

devWizard.showOnStartup.description: Show the wizard every time VS Code starts. 每次启动 VS Code 时弹出向导。

devWizard.projectsRoot.description: Root folder where new projects are created. Empty = use templatesRoot. 新工程存放目录（留空则与模板目录一致）。

devWizard.templatesRoot.description: Folder containing project templates (each subfolder = one template, optional .wizard.json manifest). 工程模板目录（每个子文件夹即一个模板，可用 .wizard.json 自定义）。

devWizard.condaRoot.description: Anaconda/Miniconda install root for the Python template's env picker (auto-detected from python.condaPath or common locations when empty). conda 安装根目录，供 Python 模板选择环境用（留空则自动探测）。

devWizard.writeContextFile.description: Auto-generate .dev-wizard/context.md when creating a new project (helps AI assistants understand the project). 创建工程时自动生成上下文文件。

devWizard.gitInitOnCreate.description: Prompt to git init + initial commit after creating a project. 创建工程后提示 git 初始化并提交。

devWizard.allowAfterCreate.description: How to handle afterCreate commands in templates: ask (confirm each), allow (run silently), deny (skip all). 模板中 afterCreate 命令的处理方式。
